# pidginhost_kubernetes_port_forward (Resource)

Forwards a public port of a Kubernetes cluster to an address inside the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pidginhost_kubernetes_port_forward" "ssh" {
  cluster_id  = pidginhost_kubernetes_cluster.example.id
  port        = 2222
  protocol    = "tcp"
  internal_ip = "192.0.2.10"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) ID of the Kubernetes cluster. Changing it replaces the object.
- `internal_ip` (String) IPv4 address inside the cluster that receives the traffic.
- `port` (Number) Public port to forward, up to 32767. Changing it replaces the port forward.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol: tcp or udp. Changing it replaces the port forward.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object in the PidginHost API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a port forward as <cluster_id>/<id>.
terraform import pidginhost_kubernetes_port_forward.ssh 7/3
```
